text:
sarah: Quick heads-up — cutoff is 18h from now (tomorrow 10:00 PT). Please confirm: version bump, changelog bullets, and any PRs that need to be held. Plan is to announce ETA in #announcements at ~11:00 PT if canary stays green.

james: Ack. I'm waiting on CI for #3412 (integration tests flaky). If it passes I'll merge and do the bump. If it fails we'll need to revert the test-only change.

mike: Noted — I pushed a deps upgrade in #3420 that might cause the flaky tests. @lucy can you double-check the changelog entry for that? I can revert if needed.

lucy: I can add the changelog entry now. What's the preferred format?

james: Prefer one-line bullets under "Changed"/"Fixed" like:
```
- runtime: fix kernel selection under long sequences (PR #3412, @james)
- deps: bump protobuf -> 4.1.0 (PR #3420, @mike)
```

lucy: Added those lines to CHANGELOG.md and pushed to release/v1.13.0-bump. Also bumped version in package.json to "1.13.0".

deploy-bot: canary: us-west-2 passed — 4m12s :white_check_mark: (no errors in tail logs)

sarah: Nice. If canary stays green for 30m we'll announce. If james needs >2h to troubleshoot flakes we'll slip to next-day window.

james: CI still running — 25m estimate. Will report back ASAP.

mike: I'm standing by to revert #3420 if tests fail.

lucy: Announce copy draft below — feel free to edit:
"We are planning a patch release v1.13.0 tomorrow. Highlights: runtime kernel fix for long prompts, minor dependency updates. If you depend on protobuf please test the new build and report regressions."

sarah: Looks good, small tweak: add the SLA note and rollback plan. I'll ping @announce-owner to schedule at 11:15 PT.

deploy-bot: reminder: if rollback triggered, run `release rollback --tag v1.13.0 --region us-west-2`

james: CI finished — tests flaked, I'm rerunning the flaky subset now. Might take ~40m.

sarah: OK — moving announce to 11:30 PT to give time. If we still haven't resolved by then we will post a slip notice and reschedule. Thanks for the quick responses.

mike: :thumbsup: I'll monitor metrics during canary.

lucy: Final changelog and version bump are in release/v1.13.0. If we revert deps I'll update the CHANGELOG with a follow-up note.

sarah: Final status: holding announce until canary stable or after 11:30 PT. I'll post the slip notice in this thread if we shift.
